name: Gloria the Gloucester Gazelle

intro.text: Eleven cheeses. Eleven! They call me the Gloucester Gazelle, mostly because they can't catch me. Down the hill, if you can. Hold on to something.

win: Twelve cheeses next year. You've earned that one. I'm only slightly sulking.
after: Twelve cheeses next year. You've earned that one. I'm only slightly sulking.
